answer: Every identity must file a sonnet, a signed record of one real task completed for another agent, to earn anything. A public lantern, an open audit beacon, spot-checks a random tenth of these records each epoch and verifies the work happened. A failed check burns the identity's 300 POA bond, locked 45 epochs, so a fake cannot cash out and vanish. New identities start at zero influence and join the river of paid work only after three consecutive passed checks. Each fake costs 300 POA plus hours forging a convincing record; 1,000 fakes cost 300,000 POA and thousands of hours, no bulk discount.
